MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "A streaming stick feels useful because it could add streaming to my existing Samsung TV, even though the TV cannot take advantage of 4K.",
    "The TV mount fits my interest in practical accessories for equipment I already use, provided its mounting pattern and weight limits match my TV.",
    "The larger Fire tablet connects to my experience with the Fire 7, although that makes it interesting to consider rather than something I need to replace now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The iPad case would not fit my Fire 7; being a tablet accessory is not enough if it is made for a different device.",
    "The outdoor speaker and large subwoofer serve listening needs I have not expressed, while my history mostly involves practical accessories and connections.",
    "The smart display and router would add or replace equipment without a current need, and the Fire TV Cube offers little that motivates me beyond the streaming stick."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet use seems to have been taken as interest in many Amazon devices, even when they serve different purposes.",
    "My TV purchase seems to have been stretched into interest in several streaming devices and a larger audio setup, although I only see a concrete use for adding basic streaming."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of cables, memory cards, mounts, and storage accessories suggest that fitting and supporting my existing equipment matters more to me than adding new devices.",
    "Exact device compatibility matters: my Fire 7 needs a matching case, my TV needs a compatible mount, and its 720p screen gives me no reason to prioritize 4K.",
    "Interest does not always mean an immediate purchase: I would choose only one streaming stick and keep using my current tablet for now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in extending my existing devices, but assumed too much interest in new equipment and too little concern for compatibility and current need."
}
